note: A 2021 investigation of delays in the digital national identity card (Gemalto, launched August 2016), applied for and collected at police stations and identification posts, with 678,000 cards uncollected in August 2017. Authorities are reported as saying the cards would help security operatives produce crime statistics and trace suspects' records, with no system described. The national identity system, outside the typology's classes: states nothing about how stations record reports or cases.
